༄༅/ /gser chos phyi ma bzhi'i snying po sogs bzhugs/na mo mahā mu dra ya/phyag chen ga'u mar grags pa'i snying po ni/thun mgor skyabs sems/rang lha sku

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gser chos phyi ma bzhi'i snying po sogs bzhugs/

na mo mahā mu dra ya/ phyag chen ga'u mar grags pa'i snying po ni/ thun mgor skyabs sems/ rang lha sku bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams chos drug dang mtshungs/ mjug tu bsngo ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /nyams len dang po la sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum ni/ lus gnad bcas rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ de nas lus lhod bde ba/ ngag rlung rang gar bzhag /sems ma bcos pa had de/ dran pa tur re bya/ yang na thol skyes rbad gcod dam/ yengs pa'i ngo bo de ka la ce re lta/ rtog pa rgya 'byams byung na zhe bcad dang 'dun pa shugs can dang*/ dran pa rtag tu brtan pa sgrims/ thun mtshams kun du sems snang dbyer med la rang gar had de 'jog pa'i sgom dang*/ ma bral bya byed spyod lam chos spyod kun dang 'dres te dran 'dun gal che'o/ /de nas rags phra rgyang ring thung*/ gyen thur bar gsum/ mdo 'don sngags bzla/ gtam sna tshogs spyod lam kun dang*/ khyad par rtog pa tshoms/ dka' tshad la rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs gsung*/ gtso bor dmigs/ rten gang yang med par che re 'jog /nang du gzhug la sems rang la lhan ne lta/ rnam rtog ched du dgag sgrub med ngo mi shes su ye ma song ba gal che'o/ /de na sems tshol bya ste/ ji ltar skye 'gag gnas/ ngo bo gcig bzhir gcig lus sam ming ngam/ spyi bo'i dngos po gang la 'dug /gcig gam/ tha dad du 'dug /gzugs su 'dug gam/ shes pa'am cing med du 'dug ches kha nang du phyogs la rang gis rang la brda sbyor ro/ /dngos po ni skyon bzhi rang grol ni/ lar phyag chen bya ba bzang bzang skad pa/ bde bde mo/ stong stong po/ gsal gsal mo zhig gi ched 'dzin gyis phud du btang*/ don med du rang bzhag pas bcings pa yin/ de tha mal shes pa yengs med rjed che re ba ngos bzung med pa la gsal rig ge pa/ snang ba ci yang 'char ba la/ gnas rung 'gyu rung rang stong rtsa bral du thag le ba/ so khad de ba/ lhug ge ba/

ye re ba/ ci snang yang cha le ba/ 'di ka bzang ngan gang gis yang ma bcos pa/ bcos rung de ka la ma 'da' ba'i rang grol 'di ka la/ 'khor 'das snang ba thams cad 'di'i cho 'phrul tsam/ 'di rang ngo bo yin min yong med las ye nas 'das 'di nye grags ngo ma shes*/ zab grags ngo ma zin/ sla grags yid ma ches bzang grags blor ma chud pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ rgyun du ngo shes kyi dran pa dang ma bral bar nyon mongs gang skyer rang stong tshul mi thub wal le ba 'khyer ba gnang*/ yang skabs su nyon mongs pa'i yul yid la byas nas ched du bcug la/ de kha'i ngo la cher re 'jog dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi sems ci byung la de ltar bskyang ngo*/ /rjes sku gsum rang shar ni/ 'di la sgom bogs thon nas/ snang ba ci shar la sems kyi rtsal gang yang ci yang 'char kyang*/ rnam rtog rang kha gdod ma nas ye skye rgyu rang med pa/ sems rang ngo shes pa'i thag chos rtsal phral du 'ong rtogs 'ongs/ mnyam rjes dbyer med du 'dres/ rgya ma chad/ phyogs su ma lhung ba'i rtsal 'gag med dgu yangs rgya 'byams nyams len gyi snying po phyogs med du 'char ba dang*/ spyod lam tho cho dang*/ sgom tshogs tshol du mi 'gro ba yin/ de la dang po nas snang stong dbyer med/ sku gsum rang grol te/ de'i dus rang shar pa yin/ yengs med dang thag chod kyis skyangs pa gal che/ dmigs pa med pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gags pa'i ngang nas thabs lam rnams dang*/ mos gus dang snying rje bogs 'don/ spros bcas kyi dge ba thams cad spros med rtsa bral ngang nas bogs phyungs pa'i rdo rje 'chang mngon du byed pa gdon mi za'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i snying po bstan pa 'di yang dad ldan slob ma 'gas bskul te dge slong spong pa par rdzu ba kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas grub pa'i gnas mchog bsam sdings su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti pra dza bh+yaḥ

mthu stobs dbang phyug 'jig rten kun la dbang bsgyur ba/ /gang gi sku la lha rdzas mchog 'di 'bul lags na/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dran par gyis shig rgyal ba yis/ /bstan la gnod byed 'di dag myur du brlag par mdzod/ /'gro ba kun gyi mgon gyur pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /bshes gnyen dam par bcas pa dag /khyod kyi yongs su skyongs par rigs/ /mahāsamayananahūṃ/ maṅga la bstir ku ru/ brtse chen gyi chos bsrungs la'o/ / ༈ oṃ swā sti dza sebhaban+tumahākāl+yaṃ/ mig sman rjes 'gro dus mtha'i rlung shugs can/ /stong gsum skad cig gis 'khor bdud kyi sde/ /ma lus 'thag la mngon rtsol rta mchog 'di/ /rdo rje nag po chen po rten du 'bul/ /dge la bar gcod ma lus bdud dpung dang*/ /chos spyod la 'tshe bstan dgra gdug can rnams/ /drag po'i me lce stong gis mi bzad pa/ /mngon spyod rdo rjes skad cig nyid la sgrol/ /srid mtsho brgal phyir thar 'dod don mthun gang*/ /dam chos gru chen gzings rnams dam du yang*/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis rjes bzung phyi nang gi / 'jigs pa kun las g.yel ba med du srungs/ / ting skyes brag dkar mgon gyi drak+shad la rta nag gi gzungs btsugs pa'i tshig go /maṅga laṃ/ oṃ samadza/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 228 -- PAGE 229 -- PAGE 226 -
